seg.notes: FY2008 10-K Note 15 (three reportable segments; segment revenues incl. intersegment; total intersegment -261.4). Per-segment intersegment split (agg -206.2, A&C -0.6 [other_seg_interseg], cement -54.6) first published in the Q4-09 release / FY2009 10-K. Asphalt mix and Concrete is one combined reporting segment -> other_seg_* (other_seg_dda 61.0 added key); asph_*/conc_* hold volumes & prices only. The Q4-08 release showed Aggregates revenue 2,404.5 and intersegment -259.1 (10-K used). Volumes/prices per Q4-08 release (agg tons incl. 15.9m internal; cement 1.039m tons at $96.75/ton). Revenue check: 3,714.5 - 261.4 + 198.4 = 3,651.5 vs 3,651.4 (rounding).

is.notes: FY2008 10-K as originally reported (used instead of the Q4-08 release because the 10-K recorded the 252.7 pre-tax / 227.6 after-tax cement goodwill impairment that the Feb-2009 release did not include; release showed op earnings 501.8, EBT 327.7, tax 96.7, cont ops 231.0, net earnings 228.6, diluted EPS 2.06, diluted shares 111.0). Minority interest (0.283) is netted inside other operating (income) expense in the 10-K. interest = 172.8 - 3.1 interest income. Diluted shares = basic due to loss. Gain on sale includes 73.8 gain on DOJ-required Florida Rock divestitures. Later restated (FY2009 10-K Note 20): tax 71.7, cont ops 3.4, net earnings 0.9, diluted EPS 0.01.

ngaap.notes: EBITDA 886.5 per Q4-08 release Table G (EBIT 497.4 + DDA 389.1; pre-impairment basis). The FY2009 release re-presented 2008 EBITDA as 886.5 (EBIT 244.7 + goodwill impairment 252.7 + DDA 389.1), i.e. the impairment is excluded from EBITDA. Check with 10-K figures: ni_vulcan -4.1 + tax 76.7 + interest 169.7 + DDA 389.1 = 631.4; +impairment 252.7 +disc ops loss 2.4 = 886.5 (so the plain check fails by those two add-backs). Adjusted EPS 1.74 and its bridge are from the Q4-08 release, which started from pre-impairment GAAP cont-ops EPS 2.08; the 10-K GAAP cont-ops EPS was -0.02 (impairment $2.07/sh). No Adjusted EBITDA published. Cash earnings 624.4 (EBITDA - net interest - current taxes) published (added key). MD&A cites record cash earnings per ton of aggregates but no figure.
